subject: VenturoTech vendor onboarding — PO issuance & spend cap question
messages:
From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@venturotech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procure_ops@venturotech.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: VenturoTech onboarding: initial forms + PO request

Hi Rishi / Priyom,

Thanks for the quick onboarding path — attached is our completed onboarding packet (VenturoTech_Onboarding_Form.pdf) and a signed W9. A couple of items we need to land to start billing against Redwood:

- Provisional PO number (we can invoice once a PO is in place)
- Initial spend cap guidance for the trial period (we propose a $30k/month test window)
- Clarification on how you want line items split — we originally submitted a bundled SKU (DEV-STACK-1) but can split into runtime / support lines if that makes the PO cleaner.

Attached: VenturoTech_Onboarding_Form.pdf, VenturoTech_Signed_W9.pdf. I can also send a CSV with the SKU breakout if helpful.

Let me know what you need from procurement side to issue a provisional PO and if you want our billing contact to be looped in separately.

Thanks,
Sasha Ivanov
Head of Finance Operations
VenturoTech
[sasha.ivanov@venturotech.com]

[Attachment: VenturoTech_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: VenturoTech_Signed_W9.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@venturotech.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VenturoTech onboarding: initial forms + PO request

Hi Sasha — thanks for sending these over and for the W9. Quick clarifying Qs before I open a procurement ticket:

1) SKU split: can you send the CSV with the two-line breakout (runtime tokens vs. premium support)? That will make the PO line items match our ledger.
2) Billing cadence: monthly or net-30 invoices?
3) Trial spend cap: you suggested $30k/month — do you expect to exceed that in month 1 if usage spikes?

I will loop procurement (Priyom) for provisional PO issuance — Priyom / Kimberly, can you confirm the earliest we can provisionally assign a PO ID and a short-term spend cap? If procurement needs a suggested temporary PO string from us I can propose one to speed things up.

Sasha — if it helps, send the SKU CSV and I’ll push this through.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00

Hi Rishi — attaching the SKU breakout as requested. We split DEV-STACK-1 into:

- VT-RUNTIME (estimated monthly qty 1,200 units)
- VT-SUPPORT (flat monthly fee)

Billing cadence: monthly invoices, net-30. For the trial we are comfortable with a hard cap of $30,000/month for the first 60 days; we’ll notify you if there’s a projected spike.

Also included the vendor invoice contact: procure_ops@venturotech.com.

Thanks — please let us know the provisional PO string and we’ll plan the initial invoice against it.

Cheers,
Sasha

[Attachment: VenturoTech_SKU_breakdown.csv (CSV)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: provisional PO request for VenturoTech (D-82719) — split lines + $30k trial cap

Priyom / Kimberly — please can procurement provisionally issue a PO for VenturoTech so they can submit the first invoice. Details below pulled from Sasha’s CSV:

Vendor: VenturoTech (procure_ops@venturotech.com)
Suggested provisional PO id (for tracking only): PO-2026-82719-PROV
Trial spend cap: $30,000 USD per month for first 60 days (review after 60 days)
Line items to appear on PO (please split exactly as listed):
- VT-RUNTIME — unit: token-hours — qty (est): 1,200 — unit price: TBD (vendor will invoice actuals)
- VT-SUPPORT — unit: monthly-fee — qty: 1 — unit price: TBD

Notes / ask:
- If procurement prefers a different provisional numbering pattern, please assign and reply with the canonical PO string; we will pass it back to VenturoTech.
- Kimberly — can you confirm the spend cap is acceptable from a compliance/credit perspective and whether we need any additional evidence (e.g., SOC2 statement) prior to issuance? Sasha already provided a W9 and onboarding form.

Sasha (cc’d): once procurement confirms the PO string we’ll respond with the exact PO to invoice against. Also flagging that we prefer separate line items so our billing matches ledger categories.

Thanks — quick turnaround requested from procurement so they can invoice this week.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: copy of VenturoTech_SKU_breakdown.csv]
